answer: Bond-and-vouch gating: each new agent locks a stake that sits idle like a boat tied at a jetty, earning nothing until the dawn of its fifth epoch of graded work. Sponsors co-sign and forfeit part of their own bond if the newcomer is later flagged, so one exposed sybil sends a ripple of slashing back through its vouchers. Faking 1,000 agents means locking 1,000 bonds, paying five epochs of real work each, and finding honest sponsors willing to risk theirs.
